description: This file implements session management for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP, including functions for session serialization, regeneration, creation, and garbage collection, as well as a class for database connection handling.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A class managing database-backed PHP sessions, including connection setup, session read/write, destroy, and garbage collection.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Get or set the database driver used for session storage.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Get or set the database hostname.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Get or set the database connection username.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Get or set the database connection password.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Get or set the database name.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Get or set the persistence mode of the database connection.

methods.name: lifetime
methods.description: Get or set the session lifetime.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Get or set debug mode for database connection.

methods.name: expireNotify
methods.description: Get or set the garbage collection notification callback.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Get or set the name of the session table.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Get or set whether to optimize the session table during garbage collection.

methods.name: clob
methods.description: Get or set whether CLOBs are used for session data storage.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Get or set the data filter objects for session data.

methods.name: encryptionKey
methods.description: Get or set the encryption key for encrypted sessions.

methods.name: _conn
methods.description: Get the current database connection object.

methods.name: _crc
methods.description: Get or set the CRC checksum for session data.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initialize the session handler by setting PHP's session save handler.

methods.name: _sessionKey
methods.description: Generate a cryptographic key for session encryption.

methods.name: _dumprs
methods.description: Dump the recordset for debugging purposes.

methods.name: isConnectionMysql
methods.description: Check if the current database connection is MySQL.

methods.name: isConnectionPostgres
methods.description: Check if the current database connection is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configure database connection parameters for session management.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establish a database connection for session storage.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the database connection (no-op here).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read session data from the database.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write session data to the database.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroy a session in the database.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Perform garbage collection of expired sessions.
